note: Contrarian Shark · angle steel-man-the-premise. Premises granted at their strongest, then refuted only where they still miss the North Star. Changelog was opaque (N× “search/replace”), so findings rest on draft text alone.

findings.section: Binding definitions (“end-to-end”); Success criteria; W9–W21; W22
findings.criterion: John can open, run, stop, and restart real Anchor work — including Doctor diagnose and session attach
findings.message: Steel-man the plan’s central premise: “we never claim MET until S1; waves only stamp CANDIDATE-MET at rendered-string level; named failure is as good as success for honesty.” That is a strong anti-lying design. It still refutes the North Star’s primary clause. The North Star is a capability claim (“John can … real Anchor work”), not an honesty-on-failure claim. Every surface wave is allowed to go GREEN while the success path is never required: pending, unknown, cannot_*, measurement_failed, or unavailable are all valid “closures.” CANDIDATE-MET therefore means “structure that can fail honestly,” not “John can do the work.” Deferring the only success proof to S1 (W22) after ~21 structural waves makes the failure half of “works end-to-end or fails with a named state” the build’s actual optimization target. Even granted perfect disclosure, the plan can exhaust the build proving it never lies while never proving John can open, run, stop, restart, diagnose, or attach real work. Require at least one forced success-path proof per North-Star verb before that criterion may leave OPEN—mid-build, not only at the S1 cliff—or stop calling structural waves “closing” those criteria.

findings.section: Success criteria (Stop summary + restart); W16; W1 task triple; NORTH-STAR CONTROL DECISION (W5)
findings.criterion: John can open, run, stop, and restart real Anchor work
findings.message: Steel-man: stop is covered because the task triple includes stop-restart, W16 ships an inventory-backed stop summary, and W17 covers restart. That still fails. The North Star lists stop as a peer of open/run/restart. The plan’s success criteria and Phase-3 waves engineer open (W10), run (W10), attach (W11), diagnose (W14–15), restart (W17), and a post-stop summary tile (W16)—not a dead-control contract, cannot-stop reasons, or e2e trace for the Stop control itself. A stop that no-ops, double-fires, or leaves work running can still produce a pretty “nothing in flight / unknown” summary. W5’s control table is said to cover stop, but no surface wave is the forced build-now for Stop the way W10 is for Open/Run. Inventory-backed summary after stop ≠ stop works. Add an explicit Stop control wave (or fold Stop into W16 with the same dead-control + named cannot-stop + e2e obligations as Open/Run), or the stop clause of the North Star has no structural owner.

findings.section: Binding definitions (Vocabulary bijection); W8 STATE-VOCABULARY-MAP; Hardening-gate failure-state table vocabulary
findings.message: Steel-man: one machine-read bijection plus table_validator.py makes unknown/empty/zero uncollapsible. The draft then breaks its own premise. Bijection is defined as “every term on both sides appears exactly once.” The hardening row empty-but-valid is required to split into empty, zero_measured, and pending—three surface-native NamedStates from one dependency term. That is a one-to-many map, not a bijection. Either (a) the validator enforces true 1:1 and cannot accept the mandatory split, or (b) “bijection” is prose and the map is many-valued, so “appears exactly once” is false and the gate cannot do what Binding definitions claim. The honesty law this plan exists to kill (merging empty with zero/unknown) sits on that map. Replace “bijection / exactly once” with an explicit, testable relation (e.g. total function from dependency rows to one or more NamedStates, with required coverage of empty and zero_measured as separate surface rows) and make table_validator enforce that relation—or the trichotomy is not machine-enforced as advertised.

findings.topic: rendered-string proof never requires real work success
findings.section: Binding definitions (“end-to-end”); W9 trace schema; W10–W20 done-whens; W22 S1
findings.criterion: works end-to-end or fails with a named, user-visible state; Steward conversational proof is S1, not a silent claim of this build
findings.message: Steel-man: the plan is unusually careful—proof_level: rendered-string, terminal status refuses unqualified “met,” S1 alone converts CANDIDATE-MET→MET. That protects against silent green. It does not protect the North Star’s “real Anchor work” requirement. W9–W21 define end-to-end as control→handler→capability→generate_html text nodes + node --check + induced faults. No wave requires a live engine session, a real open of real work, a real stop of real work, or a diagnose against a live Doctor reading outside fixtures. So the strongest reading of the plan is: “we will never pretend string-proof is user-proof.” The weakest consequence is also true: the entire structural build can be GREEN with zero evidence that real work ever succeeded. S1 is not a backstop on a mostly-proven system; it is the first and only success trial of the North Star verbs. That is a validation cliff, not progressive proof. Either insert mandatory live-success gates (even narrow ones) for open/run/stop/restart/attach/diagnose before W21 may stamp CANDIDATE-MET, or rewrite success criteria so structural waves may not claim to “close” those criteria at all—only “instrument and fail-honest.”

findings.section: W3 Capability Inventory; W5 NORTH-STAR CONTROL DECISION; W10 dead_control.py
findings.message: Steel-man: PRESENT requires live probe, transcript, source hash, 14-day bound, and replay-only PRESENT cannot ship a live control—stronger than most inventory schemes. Still insufficient for the North Star. PRESENT answers “is there a bound control / capability on this build?” Dead-control elimination answers “no clickable no-op.” Neither answers “invoking the control performs real work without silent failure.” W10’s contract emits the control whenever inventory is PRESENT and non-STALE; enumerated CannotOpen/CannotRun reasons cover only listed failures. An unlisted failure mode can still yield a live button that misleads (wrong project, half-open session, run handle that never starts)—not a “dead control,” but exactly the user-visible harm the North Star lists alongside dead controls. The freeze path “PRESENT + John’s no further work” can remove build work while leaving only trace/table obligations. Steel-man fails: absence of dead controls ≠ presence of working controls. Tie PRESENT-for-shipping to a success-path probe (or keep the control hidden until a success contract passes), not merely to “handler bound / not canned seed.”

findings.topic: usage and cost CANDIDATE-MET without working measurement
findings.section: W4 Rollup Evidence Gate; W12 Usage + time; W13 Cost; Success criteria criterion 3
findings.criterion: Every surface that claims health, usage, or diagnose either works end-to-end or fails with a named, user-visible state; Cost never fabricates dollars
findings.message: Steel-man: W4 separates NO_AGGREGATOR / READ_FAILED / PROVEN(zero_measured|empty|nonzero); W12/W13 only render through those verdicts and cost_state; dollars never invent from zero. Structurally clean. Consequence: every usage/time rollup may remain NO_AGGREGATOR → perpetual pending, and every cost path unmeasured/measurement_failed, while W12/W13 still done-when and criterion 3 still CANDIDATE-MET. The surfaces “claim” usage/cost by existing as tiles; they only ever show named non-values. That satisfies the failure branch and the anti-fabrication rule, and simultaneously never delivers working usage or cost on v1.2. W12’s Depends-on lists W9 only (not W4); even granting freeze_gate as a cross-cut, nothing requires any rollup to be PROVEN before criterion 3 may candidate-close. For a North Star that names usage as a claimed surface, “all pending forever” is not a closed honesty story—it is an abandoned success story with good labels. Require a minimum PROVEN set (or an explicit signed exit that usage/cost are out of this build with no claiming tiles) before criterion 3 may leave OPEN.

findings.section: Success criteria (Doctor); W14 banner_handoff; W15 engines; North Star “health, usage, or diagnose”
findings.criterion: Every surface that claims health, usage, or diagnose either works end-to-end or fails with a named, user-visible state
findings.message: Steel-man: Doctor diagnose (W14) plus per-engine depth (W15) plus banner→Doctor payload integrity cover “health” because the banner is only an entry point into Doctor. The North Star separately names surfaces that claim health. A health banner that shows green/ok from stale, partial, or one-engine echo while Doctor is honest only after click is still a health-claiming surface that can lie. W14 asserts payload id/hash propagation and bans seed prose in findings; it does not give the banner its own failure-state table, unknown≠empty≠zero (or healthy≠unknown≠degraded) contract, or e2e under induced health-probe faults. Cadence (W20) is status telemetry, not the health claim. Without a first-class honesty contract for the health-claiming chrome itself, the plan steel-mans “diagnose works” while leaving “claims health” unowned.

findings.topic: S1 single-point reversal after full structural spend
findings.section: W2 terminal_status; W21 CANDIDATE-MET matrix; W22 S1
findings.criterion: Steward conversational proof is a post-build validation session (S1), not a silent claim of this build; John can open, run, stop, and restart…
findings.message: Steel-man: S1-only MET and BUILD_BLOCKING for the four violation classes correctly implement “not a silent claim of this build.” The premise that this makes the plan safe still fails operationally. W21 may mark criteria 1–10 CANDIDATE-MET after string-level greens; W22 is the first live multi-verb session with John. Any S1 failure reverts criteria to OPEN after the budget for W1–W21 is spent. The plan’s own exit-conjunction and insertion caps manage structural exits, not “we built the wrong thing for 21 waves.” Steel-man of late human validation assumes structural waves reduce S1 risk; under this draft they mostly reduce lying risk. That is valuable and insufficient. Add cheap live checkpoints (even single-verb) after W10 and after Doctor/restart waves, or accept that CANDIDATE-MET rows are not progress markers toward the North Star and must not be reported as such in terminal status.

findings.topic: restart audit only over self-enumerated contexts
findings.criterion: stop, and restart … without meeting a dead control; exactly one restart control per restart context (success criteria)
findings.message: Steel-man: written contracts, one entry point per context, HTML audit count==1, preserved/lost tested against the contract—solid for listed contexts. The enumeration is produced in the same wave that audits it (RESTART-CONTEXTS.md is a W17 deliverable). An incomplete list makes the audit pass vacuously: dual competing controls in an unlisted chrome never fail. “Exactly one restart control per restart context” is only as strong as an independent, freeze-time inventory of restart surfaces (W3/W5), not a wave-local list authored beside the code under test. Bind the audit to a W3/W5-frozen context list; treat any rendered restart control whose context id is absent from the freeze as an automatic fail.

findings.topic: cost anti-fabrication limited to spot-check sample and render_cost
findings.section: W4 cost spot-check; W7 render_cost; W13 cost surfaces
findings.message: Steel-man: 0-cent tolerance, independent second procedure, mid-migration fail-closed to measurement_failed, zero×state matrix, zero_inference_lint—strong against the classic 0⇒subscription bug. Gaps remain. Spot-check is ≥20 sessions / ≥3 per engine over 30 days: agreement on the sample does not constrain unsampled engines, windows, or code paths. W13 removes “every direct dollar-format call site” by aspiration; enforcement is lint + tests in-wave, not a repo-wide forbid on non-render_cost formatters that later waves might add. E2 is banned for dollars, but a measured wrong number that passed a thin spot-check still fabricates dollars. Either widen the gate (all instrumented engines, or continuous reconciliation hook with measurement_failed on drift) or state honestly that the build proves “no zero-inference labelling” and “sample agreement,” not global non-fabrication.

findings.topic: early vertical slice still non-user e2e
findings.criterion: John can open, run … real Anchor work; works end-to-end …
findings.message: Steel-man: naming W10 as a partial early slice and writing EARLY-SLICE-PARTIAL.md prevents readers from mistaking open/run string-honesty for the full North Star—good. The premise that this slice “engineers the leading clause” still overclaims. After W10 the build has open/run dead-control structure and rendered-string traces, explicitly not a human-driven path and explicitly PARTIAL. The leading North Star clause is not advanced in the North Star’s own sense of “John can … real work”; only the honesty scaffolding for two controls is. Keep the slice, but forbid any status language that open/run criteria are “candidate-closed” solely by W10 unless a live success observation (even a single John-witnessed open+run) is attached. Otherwise the “early value” premise is morale theater.

findings.topic: W12 dependency graph omits rollup gate
findings.section: W12 Depends on; W4; W5 freeze_gate
findings.criterion: usage … works end-to-end or fails with named state; only after rollup evidence gate (success criteria)
findings.message: Steel-man: freeze_gate.py blocks all surface waves until inventory+rollup hashes match, so a missing Depends-on edge is cosmetic. Foreman-style orchestration still uses the wave Depends-on graph for scheduling and resume. W12 lists Depends on W9 only, while success criteria say usage/time only after the rollup evidence gate. If freeze_gate is skipped, mis-ordered, or reimplemented incompletely under resume, usage can build against an empty registry. Encode W4 and W5 as hard Depends-on for W12/W13 (and any rollup consumer), not only as a side tool check—duplicate the constraint where the engine actually looks.

findings.criterion: preview that dumps raw binary; File preview human-friendly Office/PDF
findings.message: Steel-man: binary guard + per-format fixtures + no raw signatures in HTML kills the dump-as-text failure mode even if the shared path is imperfect. The deliverable text still says “reusing the working new-window renderer.” If W3 marks preview STUB or the “working” path is environment-specific, W18 may wrap a non-working path and still pass HTML absence-of-bytes tests with shallow stubs. Require the shared path’s PRESENT (or a build-it sub-step) as a gate input to W18, and define “human-friendly” as asserted content shape per format—not only “no PK\x03\x04.”

findings.criterion: Doctor: real diagnose; every surface that claims … diagnose works end-to-end or fails named
findings.message: Steel-man: live readings required, seed strings banned, anti-template fault outside the table, payload hash integrity—far better than shell/seed theater. Residual hole: expected finding shape per contracted fault can still be satisfied by shallow “reading quoted, prose generic” diagnostics that look real in tests and fail John in S1. Accept as residual risk or require at least one fault whose correct finding is a structured field assertion (path exists, version matches, count threshold) not only “quotes a reading.”

The section is titled “trichotomy” and then defines four words (empty, zero_measured, unknown, pending) and forbids a fifth. Naming is inconsistent; fix the label to “state tetrad” / “four-way state vocabulary” so implementers do not assume three buckets and merge pending into unknown. Out of scope for North Star severity; do not promote.

The reviser’s changelog is fifty identical “Applied a search/replace patch” lines—no semantic delta. That prevents sharks from targeting what changed. Process hygiene only; demote. Future revisions should list wave/section-level intent.
